title: Pre-development Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
In pre-development we test new product ideas.

What you'll do
- Build and test functional prototypes
- Design mounting brackets in Inventor
- Document the trials

What you bring
- Degree in mechatronics or mechanical engineering, initial experience
- A work permit for Germany is required; we are happy to support you with a visa application
- German skills from B1 upwards
